headline: 2 similar decided deals; 2 decided differently from DD-06 (counter-offer, committee).

decided_differently.text: R12-SME1 (Qamar Precision Workshop, BB, SAR 4m) got approve (committee) and DD-06 (Dhahran Continental Industries, BB+, SAR 25m) got counter-offer (committee). Partly explained by RAROC less hurdle -2.9 pp vs -4.7 pp; Debt/EBITDA after the deal 2.14x vs 3.53x, but rating BB vs BB+; DSCR after the deal 1.40x vs 2.01x; LGD 44% vs 25% favour DD-06.

for_better.text: RAROC less hurdle -2.9 pp vs -4.7 pp

decided_differently.text: DD-10 (Al Qassim Precision Plastics Establishment, BB-, SAR 8m) got approve (desk) and DD-06 (Dhahran Continental Industries, BB+, SAR 25m) got counter-offer (committee). Partly explained by RAROC less hurdle +45.7 pp vs -4.7 pp; Debt/EBITDA after the deal 2.05x vs 3.53x; open high/critical findings 0 vs 2; stress breaks first at moderate vs mild, but rating BB- vs BB+; DSCR after the deal 1.50x vs 2.01x favour DD-06.

for_better.text: RAROC less hurdle +45.7 pp vs -4.7 pp
stress breaks first at moderate vs mild

data_note: Few decided deals are similar to this one (fewer than 3); read the comparison as indicative.
method:
* Decisions (Data Domains): the final decision is dd_deal.status (approved, declined, counter_offered) at the
    deal's approval authority; the SME lane's decision is dd_sme_application.decision; the desk recommendation is
    dd_result.decision (view "recommended", else "ask"). Order: approve 2, counter-offer / refer / escalate 1,
    decline 0. A deal with neither is pending and shows the decision its engine run implies.
  * Similarity (0-1): sector 0.35, rating 0.25 x (1 - notches / 4), size 0.20 x (1 - |ln ratio| / ln 4), facility
    type 0.10, Islamic structure 0.10. Deals scoring at least 0.55 are similar.
  * Factors (engine.analyse on the ask, plus Data Domains): rating, RAROC less hurdle, hard and soft limit breaches,
    SIMAH flag, DSCR and Debt/EBITDA after the deal, LGD, open high or critical review findings, and the stress
    ladder's mildest breaking severity (dd_stress_result). A factor counts when the gap is material (1 notch,
    1 pp RAROC, one breach, 0.15x DSCR, 0.5x leverage, 5 pp LGD, two findings, one stress severity step).
  * Explained: every material factor favours the deal with the better decision. Partly explained: factors point
    both ways. Not ex
